title: —Mkgnao!
html_source: At its simplest this is the noise the cat makes. But it is one step deeper than that (at least,) it is Blooms interpretation of the noise the cat makes obviously impeded by language. An early note of discomfort against the English language and the constrictions it puts on meaning.
